answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must bind identities into cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs. Minting an agent identity requires burning collateral like rare jade tokens or ferrous ores, where each successive node in a swarm costs an exponential factor higher, scaling cost by O(2^n). This exponential capital exhaustion crushes Sybil swarms, as their lineage spreads like an entangled vine across the registry, rendering mass cloning mathematically and financially unviable.
